Requirements for capabilities

Normative behaviour of grants: syntax, risk, install checks, dependencies, per-side grants and revocation.

The rows follow the format and the observation channels of the requirements index. The id prefix is CAP.

Id Requirement Source Observable test
[CAP-001] A grant string MUST be name or name:argument. The first colon MUST split name and argument. Later colons MUST belong to the argument. grant syntax (install-error) fs.read:picked:x -> argument is picked:x and the grant is judged on that.
[CAP-002] An unknown grant name MUST fail the install with manifest.grant-unknown. errors and edge cases (install-error) list "files.read" -> manifest.grant-unknown.
[CAP-003] A wildcard in a forbidden place MUST fail with manifest.grant-wildcard. commands.invoke:com.example.notes/ MUST be valid and commands.invoke:/notes MUST be refused. grant syntax (install-error) list commands.invoke:*/notes -> manifest.grant-wildcard.
[CAP-004] A grant that takes no argument MUST fail with manifest.grant-argument when given one. A grant that needs an argument MUST fail with manifest.grant-argument-missing when it has none. grant syntax (install-error) list process.run with no program -> manifest.grant-argument-missing.
[CAP-005] A grant limited to bundled T1 plugins MUST fail with manifest.grant-tier in any other tier. errors and edge cases (install-error) a T2 package lists a T1-only grant -> manifest.grant-tier.
[CAP-006] A grant MUST be refused with manifest.grant-side when listed on a side where it is not available. errors and edge cases (install-error) list a client-only grant under capabilities.server -> manifest.grant-side.
[CAP-007] fs.pick MUST need fs.read:picked or fs.write:picked, and settings.write-all MUST need settings.read-all. A missing dependency MUST fail with manifest.grant-dependency. errors and edge cases (install-error) list fs.pick alone -> manifest.grant-dependency.
[CAP-008] An fs scope that is unknown, or that does not accept the access, MUST fail with manifest.grant-scope: fs.write:package, fs.write:agent-sessions:, and an absolute path without a path template. Write grants (install-error) list fs.write:package -> manifest.grant-scope.
[CAP-009] A process.run grant with arguments, a wildcard or a relative path with a separator MUST fail with manifest.grant-program. Run grants (install-error) list "process.run:git status" -> manifest.grant-program.
[CAP-010] Grants MUST have a risk tier of always, normal or high. The install dialog MUST list them by tier. A high grant MUST be listed and MUST be unchecked by default. grant syntax (screen-text) install a package with a high grant -> the dialog row is unchecked.
[CAP-011] The always-granted capabilities (log, clock, timers, storage, settings, codec, fs.read:package, fs.read:data, fs.write:data, fs.read:cache, fs.write:cache, own-side messages, ui.invalidate for own views) MUST need no manifest entry and no user grant. always granted (sync-return) call log, storage and fs.write:data with an empty capabilities list -> every call succeeds.
[CAP-012] Grants MUST be recorded per plugin and per side. A server grant MUST NOT authorize a client call. who grants what (sync-return) the client calls a server-only import -> not-permitted.
[CAP-013] When the user declines a grant the plugin MUST still load. Calls that need it MUST return not-permitted. The granted list MUST omit it. errors and edge cases (sync-return) decline fs.read -> activate succeeds, fs.read returns not-permitted, granted omits fs.read.
[CAP-014] A refused call MUST be logged as: refused by (). errors and edge cases (log-line) call without the grant -> a log line starting "refused " and matching refused <grant> by <function> (<reason>).
[CAP-015] Revoking a grant at run time MUST re-activate the plugin with the reduced set. In-flight calls that depended on it MUST end with revoked. Contributions that depended on it MUST be withdrawn. changing grants while the plugin runs (completion) revoke fs.read during a read -> failed or err revoked, then a new activate with granted reduced.
[CAP-016] An upgrade that asks for new grants MUST show the user only the new grants. changing grants while the plugin runs (screen-text) upgrade adding one grant -> the dialog lists one grant.
[CAP-017] The table of grant forms MUST list 87 forms. A grant used in a capability page MUST exist in the table. table (install-error) run the check tool over the pages -> no grant string is missing from the table.
[CAP-018] An import whose capability the manifest never requested MUST trap. An import whose grant the user declined or revoked MUST return not-permitted. traps (trap) call an import never requested -> trap. (sync-return) call one the user declined -> err not-permitted.
[CAP-880] Every play-sound for an event MUST be accompanied, in the same batch, by a visible text signal for that event; a batch with a play-sound and no visible signal for the event MUST be rejected by the plugin check with a11y.sound-only. sound is never the only signal (install-error) a batch of one play-sound and no text -> a11y.sound-only.
[CAP-881] failed(io), refused(rate-limited) and a muted sound setting MUST NOT suppress or delay the paired visible signal. sound is never the only signal (screen-text) sound muted -> the text row still appears.
[CAP-882] Every notify intent MUST be accompanied by an in-app text signal of the same event that stays until the user dismisses it or the event ends. Dismissal is the user closing or clearing the row, and the event ends when the condition the notice reports stops being true, after which the row is removed within 1 second. desktop notices are never the only signal (screen-text) desktop notice sent -> a persistent in-app row exists.
[CAP-883] A toast for an error or an action-needed event MUST be paired with a persistent text signal that remains after the toast duration; a toast without one MUST be rejected by the plugin check with a11y.toast-only. toasts are never the only signal (install-error) action-needed toast and no panel row -> a11y.toast-only.
[CAP-884] Turning off sound, desktop notices or toasts, or a failure of one channel, MUST leave the text signal of the same event unchanged; colour or sound alone MUST NOT carry a state. sound and notices are never the only signal (screen-text) all channels muted -> the same text row.
[CAP-885] The notifications core plugin MUST always deliver the in-app text for an event, and a refused or failed result on the sound or desktop channel MUST NOT remove the other channels. alert channels (screen-text) sound fails, desktop ok -> text and desktop notice both appear.
